name: Fellers Food Service Equipment & Design
old_description: Bringing Foodservice Equipment and Design Together Since 1945
about:
Fellers Food Service Equipment & Design operates from Springfield, Missouri, where it was founded in 1945. The company has spent decades developing its craft in foodservice equipment distribution and commercial kitchen design, serving the region from its location at 2140 Grand Street.

The business combines equipment sales with design services, maintaining a showroom and product catalog for foodservice operators. A dedicated design team works on kitchen planning and visualization, while the company stocks and sources equipment ranging from cooking and refrigeration to preparation and serving lines. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Fellers serves the foodservice and restaurant industries, including independent restaurants, institutional kitchens, and multi-unit operators. One customer noted that "Fellers works with me to achieve a best-in-class foodservice operation," reflecting the consultative approach the company takes with operators planning new builds or renovations.

The company states its mission is to provide the highest level of service, merchandise, and insights, describing a continuing mission to learn and create new, better ways for customers to do business and succeed. The focus is framed around customer success rather than product specifications alone.
